entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Hi Diana. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. I got it a couple of weeks ago.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number? And just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
The name is Sam Jones, order 225-89-alpha. And yes, it's faulty. The heart rate tracking is all over the place. It's basically just garbage.

Okay, Sam, I've pulled up your order. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the tracking. I see here the band was delivered 14 days ago. Since you're reporting a technical fault, the first step is to connect you with our tech support team. They can diagnose the issue and, if needed, get a warranty replacement started for you.
No, I don't want a replacement. Honestly, I don't have time to go back and forth with a tech team. I just want my money back. Can we please just process the refund?
I understand you'd prefer a direct refund. However, for a defect claim outside the initial return window, our process requires verification from our technical team. It's usually a very quick call.
What do you mean 'outside the window'? I thought VeloFit had a 90-day policy.

That's a great question. While most of our apparel and gear have that 90-day policy, the VeloBand Pulse, because it's a specialized electronic health device, has a strict 10-day return window for a full refund. Since we're on day 14, the policy directs us to warranty support for any performance issues.

Okay, I understand the policy, but it's only four days over. And the product isn't working as advertised. I don't think it's fair that I'm stuck with it. How about a partial credit? Maybe 50% back? That seems like a reasonable compromise.

I appreciate your willingness to find a middle ground. However, my system is firm on this policy. Without a verified defect from our support team, I'm not authorized to issue any credits or a refund for the Pulse band after the 10-day mark has passed. The hygiene and data security protocols for this specific device are very stringent.
So there's no flexibility at all? Not even a discount code for a future purchase for my trouble? I'm trying to be reasonable here.

I truly wish I could offer that, Sam, but my hands are tied by the policy for this item when a defect isn't verified. My only authorized solution at this point is a warm transfer to our tech support team. They really are the experts who can resolve this for you with a functioning device.
I see. Well, it sounds like you've told me what you can do. I'll think about whether I want to spend more time on this. Thanks for the information, Diana.
You're very welcome, Sam. Please don't hesitate to call back if you change your mind and want to connect with them. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
